item.title: Free Yoga Practice — Thu Jul 23, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community 🌀 **Move with intention. Connect with your body. Celebrate community.**
Join us every **Thursday at 6 PM** for an embodied yoga practice designed to help you release tension, ground yourself, and cultivate presence. This is a trauma-informed, all-levels class, no prior yoga experience needed. Expect a Hatha-Vinyasa flow, breathwork, and a space to listen to your body’s wisdom.
🌿 **Every last Thursday of the month, stay after class for a community potluck dinner!**
📍 **Location**: 727 T St. Sacramento CA 95811 ✨ **All our events are free. Donations are welcome.** 📩 **Questions? Reach out at** embody.iama@gmail.com 🔗 **Follow us on Instagram:** [@embody.iama](https://www.instagram.com/embody.iama)
Source: Meetup: Mindful Embodied Spirituality

item.title: Conscious Conversations & Somatic Practices — Mon Aug 10, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community This is a spiritual community that honors the body’s wisdom and lived experience. Whether you’re healing from religious trauma, deconstructing beliefs, exploring spirituality, or just want to be with other conscious persons, this space is for you.
Expect conscious conversations, meditation, breathwork, sound healing, and other somatic practices to help reconnect with ourselves and each other.
we share a potluck dinner every last Monday of the month.

item.title: Gentle yoga — Tue Aug 11, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community This is a slow and mindful practice that emphasizes deep breathing, body awareness, and nervous system regulation. This class is accessible to all abilities, providing a supportive and trauma-informed space to reconnect with the body.
Sessions alternate between floor yoga and chair yoga (on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday). Stay a bit longer on the last Tuesday of the month and join us for coffee or tea afterward!
Like all our events, this class is free, donations are welcome.
Source: Meetup: Mindful Embodied Spirituality

item.title: Register Voters at UC Davis — Mon Sep 21, 11:30 AM — UCD Quad
item.description:
Join Indivisible Yolo in registering voters for the 2026 elections! Democracy functions best when people engage in conversations about what needs to be done. On campus at UCD on Wednesday, we don't start by pushing a form. Using the Field Team 6 model, we ask questions and talk about problems that need to be addressed. We talk about how voting can be a way to get decision makers who will address those problems. Then we make sure they have everything they need to vote on November 3. You can join
Source: Indivisible Yolo (Mobilize)

item.title: Picnic in the Park at Davis Farmers Market – Wednesday Evenings (50th Anniversary Year) — Wed Oct 7, 4:00 PM — Central Park
item.description:
The beloved Picnic in the Park season is back at the Davis Farmers Market starting Wednesday, April 1, 2026! Every Wednesday evening through August 26, the market expands to 4:00 – 8:00 PM, turning Central Park into the perfect spot for a relaxed picnic dinner. Shop fresh produce, artisan goods, and a wide variety of prepared foods from your favorite vendors. Enjoy local craft beer, wine, and brand new this year – mead! Each week features live music and children’s activities, creating a festive, family-friendly atmosphere. Bring blankets, lawn chairs, and reusable bags. It’s the ideal way to unwind, connect with neighbors, and support local farmers and food makers. This year is extra special as the Davis Farmers Market celebrates its 50th Anniversary! Don’t miss the big anniversary celebration on Saturday, August 1, 2026. New in 2026: The Market Memories Cookbook (presale now at davis-farmers-market). Highlights Include:

item.title: Davis Downtown Board Meeting — Thu Oct 8, 2:00 AM — Davis Downtown Board Meeting
item.description:
Join us on the second Thursday of each month for our Governing Board of Directors meeting. The meeting is open to all interested. Stay up-to-date on business and initiatives related to downtown Davis, and the opportunity to provide public comment will be available. Meetings are currently held virtually on the Zoom platform from 9:00am to 10:00am. If you are interested in attending, please contact us at info@davisdowntown.com to request a Zoom meeting invitation. To view, download and/or print Board of Directors meeting agendas or minutes, click on the following link: https://davisdowntown.com/agendas-meeting-information. Meeting locations and times are subject to change.
Source: Davis Downtown
